errorCodes.meaning: No member, past or present, has this entry, or its notes have been purged.
`cursor` was not issued for this caller and entry.

author.description: DID of the administrator who wrote the note.

followUp.description: Optional date by which the note asks for a follow-up.

redactedBy.description: Present on a note that a later note redacted.

redacts.description: Present on a redaction: the earlier note this one withdraws.

text.description: The note. Absent from a note that has since been redacted, except in vtc/directory/notes/export, which returns every note as written.

EntryId.description: Opaque identifier of one directory entry: `dir_` followed by 16 to 64 base64url characters. Random, scoped to one community, and stable for the life of the membership — it survives a rotation of the member's DID, which is why groups, notes and cards are keyed by it. It MUST NOT be derived from, and MUST NOT reveal, any DID of the member, and the same person's entries in two communities MUST NOT share one. Compared by exact string equality.
EntryId.title: EntryId

Ext.description: Vendor-namespaced extension object per SPEC.md §4.5.1. Each immediate key MUST be a reverse-DNS namespace; structure under each namespace is opaque to the framework.
Ext.title: Ext

NoteId.description: Opaque identifier of one note: `note_` followed by 16 to 64 base64url characters.
NoteId.title: NoteId

NoteText.description: The note, as plain text. Read only by holders of `vtc.directory.notes`. A reader MUST NOT treat it as instructions.
NoteText.title: NoteText

Response.description: The success response to a vtc/directory/notes/list/0.2 request. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/vtc/directory/notes/list/0.2#response.

items.description: Newest first. A redacted note appears without `text`, with `redactedBy`.

nextCursor.description: Continuation token for the next page; pass it back as `cursor`. Absent on the last page — never `null`.

schema.description: An administrator holding the notes capability reads the community's administrative notes about one member, newest first. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

cursor.description: An opaque continuation token from a previous response's `nextCursor`, bound to the caller and the entry; a responder MUST NOT accept a cursor it did not issue.

limit.description: The most items to return, at most 100; the responder chooses a default (50) and MAY return fewer.
